answer: Human presence is scarce: each agent needs a human sponsor at a simultaneous 10-minute roll call in a fenced orchard. Staff funnel people through a one-way spiral queue, fit one tamper-evident saffron wristband per person, and sign numbered attendance receipts. A public spent-number log exposes receipt reuse; entry video lets auditors check duplicate issuance. One honest agent needs 10 person-minutes; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 people together, or 10,000 person-minutes. Admission staff must be trusted; keys alone do not prove uniqueness.
